name: smwmusic-final-fantasy-iv-the-land-of-summons
title: Final Fantasy IV - The Land of Summons
description:
(Also known as "Illusionary World" and "Town of Illusions")

The eerie theme of the Sylph Cave and the Land of Eidolons from Final Fantasy IV. Could suit really any dark cave environment, or just an overworld if you'd like. But more importantly, if you're trying to give an excuse as to why a character aged so quickly and has more summons and spells as a result, this is the theme of that excuse.
